flags.effect: all, or a comma separated list of repos, servers, access, library, tasks, settings, claudeUser, memory, history, secrets (default all: everything readable)

flags.effect: File to write, or a folder to get toolport-setup-<date>.zip in; an existing file is never replaced

flags.effect: Also write past Claude Code conversations, sealed with the passphrase from stdin; off by default
flags.name: --sessions

flags.effect: Read the passphrase (at least 12 characters, never stored, no recovery) as one line from stdin
flags.name: --passphrase-stdin

flags.name: --without

flags.effect: Only the sessions of this repository (repeatable)

flags.name: --peek
